hero.title: Empower Your Workforce.
hero.subtitle: Empower Your Business.
hero.description: International Recruitment & Workforce Solutions for European Employers. We connect European employers with reliable, skilled and motivated workers from international markets.

countstats.title: Connecting European Employers with International Talent
countstats.subtitle: Since 2010, Empowerment Recruitment has helped businesses access dependable workforce solutions across a wide range of industries.

ourpeople.title: Our People
ourpeople.subtitle: Recruitment is ultimately about people. Our team works across sourcing, candidate screening, employer coordination, documentation and recruitment support to help create successful connections between employers and candidates.

ourjourney.title: Our Journey
ourjourney.subtitle: From Recruitment Expertise to International Workforce Solutions
ourjourney.timedec1: Empowerment Recruitment was established with a focus on connecting employers with suitable international talent.
ourjourney.timedec2: Expanded recruitment activities across international source markets and developed broader employer partnerships.
ourjourney.timedec3: Strengthened digital sourcing, candidate communication and remote recruitment processes.
ourjourney.timedec4: Developed recruitment capabilities across a broader range of industries and workforce requirements.
ourjourney.timedec5: Introduced improved digital tools and technology-supported recruitment processes to enhance candidate sourcing and employer coordination.
ourjourney.timedec6: Connecting European employers with permanent and seasonal workers across 30 core industries.

industriesspecialization.title: Recruitment Expertise Across 30 Core Industries
industriesspecialization.subtitle: We provide workforce recruitment solutions across sectors that rely on dependable operational, skilled, semi-skilled, technical and seasonal workers.

ourservices.title: Our Services
ourservices.subtitle: International recruitment solutions tailored to your organization's permanent and seasonal workforce requirements.

services1.title: Permanent Recruitment
services1.desc: Long-term employment solutions across a broad range of industries and occupations.

services2.title: Seasonal Recruitment
services2.desc: Workforce solutions for businesses with seasonal staffing requirements.

services3.title: International Candidate Sourcing
services3.desc: Candidates sourced from established recruitment markets across Asia and Africa.

services4.title: Work Permit & Visa Support
services4.desc: Assistance with the documentation and procedures involved in work-permit and visa applications.

banner1.title: Ready to Strengthen Your Workforce?
banner1.subtitle: Tell us what positions you need to fill, where you need workers and what your requirements are. Our recruitment team will discuss your requirements and identify the most suitable recruitment approach.

ourorganization.title: International Recruitment & Workforce Solutions for European Employers
ourorganization.subtitle: Since 2010, Empowerment Recruitment has helped businesses access dependable workforce solutions across a wide range of industries.
ourorganization.desc: We understand that every employer has different workforce requirements. Our role is to identify suitable candidates, manage the recruitment process and support candidates through the necessary documentation, work-permit and visa procedures, helping employers move from vacancy to successful placement with greater confidence.

ourculture.title: People First. Integrity Always.
ourculture.subtitle: Our work is built on trust, transparency and responsibility. We aim to create recruitment relationships that work for both employers and candidates.

culture1.title: Integrity & Transparency
culture1.desc: We communicate honestly, act responsibly and maintain transparency throughout the recruitment process.

culture2.title: Quality
culture2.desc: We focus on suitability, reliability and the specific requirements of every vacancy.

culture3.title: Partnership
culture3.desc: We work closely with employers, candidates and recruitment partners to create long-term relationships.

culture4.title: Responsibility
culture4.desc: We take our role seriously, particularly when supporting people through an international recruitment journey.

culture5.title: Continuous Improvement
culture5.desc: We continually improve our processes, technology and recruitment capabilities to deliver a better experience.

banner2.title: Ready to Build Your Workforce?
banner2.subtitle: Tell us about your vacancies and workforce requirements.
